claim: For every real sequence space \(X=\ell_q(I)\) with \(|I|\ge2\), every \(2\le q<\infty\), and every \(\lambda\in[0,1]\), let \(r=|2\lambda-1|\). For the four-term von Neumann–Jordan constant defined by the unit-sphere supremum in arXiv:2110.15741, \[C'''_{\mathrm{NJ}}(\lambda,X)=2^{-2/q}\left((1+r^q)^{2/q}+1-r^2\right).\] This corrects the super-Hilbert \(\ell_q\) formula printed in Example 3.1 of the current revision: at \(q=4\) and \(\lambda=1/4\) the sharp value is \((\sqrt{17}+3)/(4\sqrt2)\), whereas the printed formula gives \(\sqrt7/2\).
integrity: The general theorem is analytic. The bundled computation checks a special exact checkpoint and witness only and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved for real \(\ell_q(I)\) with \(|I|\ge2\) and \(2\le q<\infty\); the \(q=\infty\) endpoint is not claimed.
The equality witness proves attainment but the full equality set is not classified.
The correction concerns the displayed unit-sphere four-term invariant only; unrelated statements of the source are outside scope.
title: Correct super-Hilbert four-term von Neumann–Jordan profile on \(\ell_q\)
